svg.title: Packaging operator — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as packaging operator, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: An open carton sits beneath a tape-sealing roll and its support arm. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: a ponytail, a softly squared face and round glasses.
